notes.title: Demo Patch 2
notes.notes: [h2]Thank you![/h2][p]A big thank you to those who have completed the feedback form, or joined the Discord and given constructive feedback - it really helps shape the future of Decaying Salvage.  I'm especially thankful to those that have acknowledged the premise of this demo, a prototype aimed to shape the game. You're awesome and I couldn't imagine doing it without you.[/p][p][/p][p]Join the Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/frUCuFyQHv"]Join The Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p]Alright, what's in the patch?[/p][list][*][p]Enemies now pause when interacting with certain puzzles.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies have more consistent health without randomisation (who knew people wouldn't like that?!)[/p][/*][*][p]The barrier to the maintenance corridor now gives players more of a clue it can be entered.[/p][/*][*][p]Invisible enemies should THIS time no longer exist - thanks MisFitPit ;)[/p][/*][*][p]A few save/load logic things have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few camera triggers[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a few instances where the player could walk off camera[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Don't forget ...[/h2][p]Join the Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/frUCuFyQHv"]Join The Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]-Drewid.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1
notes.notes: [h2]Off to a Good Start![/h2][p]First of all, a big thank you to the over 600 people who have downloaded the demo! That's an awesome start and lets me know people are seeing the game![/p][p][/p][h2]Feedback[/h2][p]Feedback is [b]extremely[/b] important, especially for a game doing early prototype testing. I'm listening, and making changes, which is why the first patch is already available. So please keep the reports coming, and the feedback on the demo coming. You can do them here:[/p][p]Join the Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/frUCuFyQHv"]Join The Discord[/url][/p][p]Give some Feedback: [url="https://forms.gle/osPoUNf51QkgoAAm9"]Open the Feedback Form[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p]Now for the important stuff, what is in this patch:[/p][list][*][p]Player can now move (and aim) using the right stick! [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few camera transitions that clipped through the world (wasn't breaking the game, but breaking immersion)[/p][/*][*][p]Fast enemies have been slowed down a little. They were causing potential soft locks as they moved at the same speed as the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Player animation speeds have been tweaked a little to improve the feel of the character movement. A major overhaul will be coming later. [/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes, an invisible enemy will be in a very specific room. I think I've tracked down the offender, and put him in quarantine. Let's hope he doesn't break loose.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a note to the control rebinding screen that explains rebinding a control will not currently update the in-game tutorials.[/p][/*][*][p]Player had a tendency, in rare circumstances, to get stuck in a permanent squat and slide around the environment. While I commend Jordan's workout routing allowing her to do that, it should now be fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Patch Plans[/h2][p]There are some larger issues, that while not game breaking do need to be addressed. But hey, that's the whole point of a [b]prototype[/b] demo! These include:[/p][list][*][p]Making more changes to the player animation system. [/p][/*][*][p]Enhancing the stun system for the enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]Much more (let me know stuff!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]The Competition[/h2][p]The Demo also includes a "1998" mode, which if you beat within 12 minutes, and are one of the first [b]5[/b], you'll win a free copy of the full game. [/p][p]There is already ONE winner :O So get running![/p][p][/p][p]Join the Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/frUCuFyQHv"]Join The Discord[/url][/p][p]Give some Feedback: [url="https://forms.gle/osPoUNf51QkgoAAm9"]Open the Feedback Form[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Thank you![/h2][p]Thank you again for playing, interacting, wishlisting and just being here, you mean a lot to me and with your help I feel Decaying Salvage can become something awesome.[/p][p][/p][p]-Drewid.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Coming September 10!
notes.notes: [p]The demo for Decaying Salvage is coming September 10![/p][p][/p][p]It's been awhile since I announced the demo was coming, and it really was meant to be out earlier, so why isn't it here already? Let's dig into it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209108/7f5f9d755daad4dfff8f8311ca1c12e8029833f3.png"][/img][/p][p]I [b]loved[/b] the initial demo, so did internal play testers. The issue stemmed from what I saw when I took a little step back and actually analysed where the game itself was heading.[/p][p][/p][p]Decaying Salvage is a love letter to games I grew up with, the original Resident Evil series back in the 90s, Silent Hill ... and I realised that I just wasn't doing things justice, but I [b]knew[/b] how to make it better.[/p][p][/p][p]By adding a few more rooms, a few more branching paths, it led to the feeling of this place being something that could actually exist, of a place that lets the player get a [b]taste[/b] of the exploration that will be in the full game, and ultimately see what the vision for Decaying Salvage is.[/p][p][/p][p]Then of course, there's the little bits like animation bugs and what have you.[/p][p][/p][p]Decaying Salvage still has a LONG way to go, don't get me wrong, but hopefully this playable early prototype will help you to see the vision, and what is to come on what I personally think is a great throwback to an old style of game I dearly love.[/p][p][/p][p]Make sure you've Wishlisted, and come back to try the demo![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo coming soon!
notes.notes:
The demo for Decaying Salvage is coming soon!

Explore a section of the first ship. Find out just what happened on board the Lapideus, find the part you need to repair your ship and [b]get the hell out of there![/b]

This demo has been quite the undertaking, and in the past month has expanded quite a bit in terms of mechanics, animations, environmental interactivity and most importantly - more added puzzles!

I'm really excited to get this out to the public, and it should be available [b]by the start of June![/b]

Thank you to all who have wishlisted and been supportive so far - I really can't wait for you to try the demo.
